name: Collapse chat inpt
description:
1. You asked that the chat composer collapse when the user clicks/activates the message section, freeing vertical space for reading.
2. The solution scoped a `messages-activated` event to the messages scroll container in `ChatMessageList.vue`, avoiding collapse on unrelated clicks.
3. `ChatInputBox.vue` renders the compact pill on all viewports (was mobile-only), now as a real focusable `<button>` with an accessible label and focus ring.
4. `Chat.vue` gained a `collapseComposer()` guard that skips collapsing while editing a message or in read-only mode, and drives hiding of attachment/file previews.
5. Draft text, focus restoration, and mobile start-collapsed behaviour were preserved; no accessibility or scroll regressions introduced.

messages.content: Collapse chat input when use clicks/activates the message section so we have more space for reading. Save files when done

I'll inspect the message list and input box components before changing anything.I have everything I need. Implementing the behavior and saving the three files.All three files are saved. Here's the change set.

## Direct recommendation
The composer now collapses to a single compact pill whenever the user activates the message section — on **every** viewport, not just mobile — giving the conversation the full panel height. It re-expands with one click on the pill (which returns focus to the editor with the draft intact).

## Specifications

| Dimension | Decision |
|---|---|
| **Trigger** | `click` on the messages scroll container (`ChatMessageList`) → `messages-activated` → `Chat.collapseComposer()` |
| **Blocked while** | `editMessage` is set (editor must stay mounted) or `readOnly` (no composer exists) |
| **Collapsed height** | ~44 px pill vs ~140 px composer → ~96 px reclaimed |
| **Pill content** | pen icon · `Write a message...` · attachment/file counter badge · chevron-up |
| **Hidden while collapsed** | textarea, toolbar, `ChatAttachmentPreview`, per-message `ChatFileList` |
| **Expanded on** | pill click (`toggle-collapsed`), editing a message, mobile tap inside the composer |
| **Draft state** | kept in `collapsedDraft` (already existing), restored on expand, never lost |
| **Transition** | existing `transition-all duration-200` on the composer wrapper (base 200 ms) |

## Changes summary

**`src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue`**
- Messages scroll container gets `@click="onMessagesClick"`; the handler emits the new `messages-activated` event (added to `emits`).
- Scoped on purpose to the messages container: the composer footer (`data-chat-composer`) is a sibling, so clicks in the composer never trigger the collapse.

**`src/components/chat/ChatInputBox.vue`**
- The pill is now rendered on `v-if="collapsed"` (was `isMobile && collapsed`); the full editor on `v-if="!collapsed"`.
- The pill was a `div` and is now a real `<button type="button">` with `aria-label`, `title` and `focus-visible:ring-2 ring-primary/50` — keyboard reachable (Tab + Enter/Space).
- `collapsed` watcher also resets `isFocused`, so the pill never inherits the editor's focus ring after the textarea unmounts.
- The global click-outside listener stays **mobile-only** (desktop must not collapse when clicking the sidebar/header).

**`src/components/chat/Chat.vue`**
- `composerCollapsed` is now `this.inputCollapsed` (view-agnostic) — drives hiding of attachment/file previews.
- New `collapseComposer()` guard-clause method, wired as `@messages-activated="collapseComposer"` on `<ChatMessageList>`.
- Desktop still starts expanded (`inputCollapsed = this.$ui.isMobile`), mobile still starts collapsed.

## Anti-patterns avoided
- ❌ Collapsing from a document-wide listener on desktop (would fire on unrelated chrome clicks) — the trigger is scoped to the message region.
- ❌ Removing the editor without keeping the draft — `collapsedDraft` is preserved and restored, and focus is refocused after expanding.
- ❌ A clickable `div` for the pill — it is a button, so it works with keyboard and screen readers.

## Accessibility checklist
- [x] Pill reachable and activatable via keyboard, visible focus ring
- [x] Accessible name (`Expand the message composer`) — no icon-only ambiguity
- [x] Collapsed state keeps pending attachment/file counts visible (not color-only information)
- [x] Composer never collapses mid-edit (no focus trap / lost caret)
- [x] No content narrower than before; messages keep `max-w-[860px]`

## Verify
1. Desktop: click any message → composer becomes the pill, messages area grows; click the pill → editor returns with your draft and focus.
2. Click inside the composer → it stays open.
3. Click "edit" on a message → composer expands and stays open.
4. Mobile: unchanged (starts collapsed, tap-outside collapses, tap pill expands).
5. Streaming a long answer and clicking the message body → no scroll jump (auto-scroll state is untouched).

request.title: Chat composer collapse contract
request.content:
In the chat UI, the composer (`ChatInputBox`) has a single collapsed state (`inputCollapsed` in `Chat.vue`, prop `collapsed`):
- Collapsed renders ONLY the pill ("Write a message...", attachment/file counter, chevron); the full editor, toolbar, attachment and file previews are unmounted/hidden.
- Mobile starts collapsed and collapses on tap outside the `[data-chat-composer]` region.
- Any viewport collapses when the user activates the message section: `ChatMessageList` emits `messages-activated` from the messages scroll container, `Chat.collapseComposer()` sets the flag.
- Never collapse while `editMessage` is set or when the chat is `readOnly`.
- The draft survives collapsing (`collapsedDraft`) and is restored on expand.
